Dear [Mr Wooldridge](/person/2094)
The house said to be occupied by E Collins is that of [Charles Ray Junior](/person/2111) [Mrs Collins](/person/360) has been dead these 30 years.

Hall ought to be Pearson John Price rents a very small cottage adjoining his shop, I believe one of Barfoot’s sons sleeps there but Price is accountable for it.
[Mrs Bishop](/person/156) is really the tenant of the whole house Ruddock is her lodger Does this make any difference?

County Police should be substituted for [J Davis](/person/2148), as the present constable is Kemp
Day is dead, his house is occupied by Mrs Jewell
Otherwise I think all is correct

Yours truly

C M Yonge
